description: Issue a short-lived, scoped token for an agent to use a secret. The agent receives an opaque token ID — never the raw secret. Use inject_secret_to_request to apply the token to an outbound request.

service.description: Service name to get a token for (must match a stored secret's service)

ttl_seconds.description: Token time-to-live in seconds (default 300 = 5 min, max 86400 = 24h)

name: get_agent_token
